purpose: Cross-check the 14 fish labels in Urmeneta's Bangalao Lake catch assessment against current fish-name authorities without replacing the original labels or treating name status as specimen identification.

input.sourceTaxonomyReference: FishBase 2018, as reported by the paper

authorities.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authorities.publisher: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authorities.accessNote: Selected current-status excerpts were available in indexed Catalog records. Direct Catalog page opens returned 403 in this review environment; no access controls were bypassed. Concise name-status summaries are retained, not Catalog text blocks.
authorities.reuse: No item-specific open reuse terms were established. Link and attribute the Catalog; do not reproduce its pages or bulk content.

authorities.name: World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS)
authorities.accessNote: The taxon detail page lists the species name as accepted and distinguishes spelling variants and synonyms.
authorities.reuse: No item-specific redistribution terms were established for this review. Link and attribute WoRMS; do not reproduce page content.

comparisonRule: Keep each Bangalao article label and count verbatim. The authority crosswalk is nomenclatural only; it cannot identify the fish caught, resolve species-by-site allocation, establish current presence, or approve public reuse.

qualityAndReuseLimits: The crosswalk covers 14 reported name strings, not 14 independently verified species identifications. Abbreviated source labels are expanded only in the separate authorityCandidate field.
The two candidate combination updates do not authorize replacing the paper's verbatim labels or identifying the fish caught.
The source is a pooled fishery catch assessment. Its site totals do not allocate taxa by site, event, or specimen; no lake-wide occurrence layer or coordinates can be derived.

Catalog range and introduced-status summaries are not proof of local introduction, stocking, absence, or source error. The Clarias batrachus range note is a priority for voucher or diagnostic evidence.
The 2018 source uses historical taxonomy and conservation references; this review does not update legal status, conservation status, diet, safety, catchability, or natural distribution claims.
The proceedings paper's reuse terms remain unverified. No source table or figure was copied into public app data, and publication approval remains false.
nextAction: Seek the paper's voucher or diagnostic documentation and any species-by-site records, exact station coordinates, and exact sample dates; keep the pooled checklist research-only. Continue screening separate Quirino Province and Batanes inland waters rather than treating Bangalao Lake as regional coverage.
